draft.headline: WINTER 2026: An idea needs a plan, and a private responsibility needs a decision
draft.summary: This season begins with imagination and structure working together.
draft.body: Late February may give an idea somewhere practical to go.

draft.headline: SUMMER 2026: An idea needs an audience and a schedule
draft.summary: Jupiter begins a new twelve-year communication cycle in July.
draft.body: Summer begins with a reason to treat one idea as a long project rather than a passing interest.

sections.heading: KEY DATES
sections.body:
**JUL 4 · Begin the longer project** · Give one idea a repeatable place in your week. **AUG 12 · An answer is needed** · A message may reach someone who can respond. *A total solar eclipse falls in your natal third house, square your natal Uranus.**AUG 12 · An answer is needed** · An announcement, submission, or piece of writing may reach someone who can respond. *A total solar eclipse falls in your natal third house, square your natal Uranus.*

**AUG 19 · Make the introduction** · Ask, present, apply, or accept the invitation that gives your work wider access. *Jupiter sextiles your natal Ascendant.**AUG 27 · Count what the yes requires** · One more yes may be harder to fit into the week than it first appears. *Jupiter squares your natal Moon in the sixth house.*

draft.headline: KEY DATES
draft.summary: These dates mark the year’s main turning points.
draft.body: Use these dates as reference points, not isolated predictions.

sections.heading: WINTER 2026
sections.body:
An idea may become easier to use once it has an outline, sequence, budget, or date. Decide what can happen now and what needs to wait. *Saturn trines your natal Jupiter.*

**FEB 26 · Follow the more meaningful direction**
A project, course of study, piece of writing, or private practice may begin making more sense. *Neptune trines your natal Jupiter.*

draft.headline: 2026 IN REVIEW
draft.summary: Home and family obligations come under review first.
draft.body: By the end of 2026, the evidence may be practical. You may have a clearer sense of which responsibility needs a handoff, which opportunity requires different terms, which schedule protects the work, and which commitment keeps taking time from the same meal, appointment, relationship, or unfinished project. You know which responsibility needs a handoff, which opportunity requires different terms, which schedule protects the work, and which commitment keeps taking time from the same meal, appointment, relationship, or unfinished project.

draft.headline: WINTER 2027: A public decision needs workable terms
draft.summary: The private work of the year begins producing visible consequences.
draft.body: January may make an unfinished home or family responsibility harder to postpone.

sections.heading: KEY DATES
sections.body: **JAN 10 · Revise the home plan** · A repair, move, household responsibility, or family arrangement may need a different sequence. *Mars stations retrograde near your natal Saturn and square your Ascendant.**FEB 5 · Terms, round 2** · Use this second pass to review the terms and identify what each person can commit to now. *Jupiter retrograde opposes your natal Mars for the second time.**FEB 6 · A public decision reaches you** · An application, title, publication, credential, or public-facing project may require an answer. *A solar eclipse in your natal ninth house conjoins your Midheaven.*
